typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 8 / request.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 8 / status.

recognitionRules: Use Bodoni display statements with Optima explanatory text.
Keep gold and warm paper secondary to dark readable text.
Separate sponsor contribution, organizer responsibility and unconfirmed assumptions.
Make the proposal status visible beside financial figures.

principles: Make the invitation warm and the practical details exact.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Support a place for people to gather. See exactly what that support would make possible.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid speaking for an entire community or implying confirmed attendance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Come for the part that interests you; here is what to expect.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use THE FESTIVAL TABLE in Bodoni with an Optima proposal descriptor and one fine gold rule. No sponsor crest or laurel.
invariants: Use Bodoni display statements with Optima explanatory text.
Keep gold and warm paper secondary to dark readable text.
Separate sponsor contribution, organizer responsibility and unconfirmed assumptions.
adaptations: A sponsor sheet keeps contribution, deliverable and decision date together.
Event-facing materials omit internal commercial assumptions.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Bodoni 72 is an Apple/system font; not bundled.
Optima is an Apple/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
